Polar Capital Global Healthcare Trust plc (the "Company")
Sale of Ordinary Shares from Treasury

The Company announces the sale of 425,000 ordinary shares of 25p each ("ordinary shares") fully paid from the Company's Treasury Account. These shares were sold for cash on 03 September 2026 at a price of 449.00 pence per share.
